title: Gaudet, Jack Carey and Mutt Carey
summary: Brief talk about Hunter Gaudet's death and who played with Jack Carey, and Mutt Carey in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: When did Gaudet die, before I forget it?
I don't remember when Gaudet died.
I'm a person to tell you, if you ask him. Recently or? Oh, quite a while back.
Ten years? I think something like that. It should be something like Ronny, time.
Well who played with Jack Carey? Who was some of the other guys?
I don't know much about, I do know a little. I played drums once or twice with him. I saw Mutt Carey, I know he used to be the trumpet man. And Hunter Gaudet, he played with Jack.
Mutt, Mutt Carey. I remember him playing second trumpet occasionally with Chris at the Bull. And I didn't get a chance to see him when he went with Ori, I think. I didn't see him anymore.
